data.name: Kanwar
data.gender_notes: Kanwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of God Krishna or Shiva, meaning 'Carrier of God's weapon'. The name Kanwar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kanaka' which means 'Golden', 'Rich' and 'Worthy'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that God Krishna or Shiva carries a 'Kanwar' or a 'Krishak', a wooden pole or a trident, respectively. The name Kanwar carries the meaning “Carrier of God's weapon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kanwar usually hope their child will grow to embody carrier of god's weapon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kanwar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Carrier of God's weapon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kanwar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
